## packages/drive/src/Actions/CopyNodeAction.php

SHA256 5f4f9c2d0255f1e99d2d9f932e26b258146c8c9aad2d42c9a127b407de5cd2c7; bytes 8790.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Actions;

use Vaulter\Contracts\Cas\BlobStore;
use Vaulter\Database\VaulterDatabase;
use Vaulter\Drive\Data\CopyNodeData;
use Vaulter\Drive\Events\NodeCopied;
use Vaulter\Drive\Exceptions\CrossStorageMoveException;
use Vaulter\Drive\Exceptions\QuotaExceededException;
use Vaulter\Enums\Drive\NodeKind;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Drive\QuotaExceededException as CoreQuotaExceededException;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Nodes\NodeNameConflictException;
use Vaulter\Models\Cas\Blob;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\File;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\FileRevision;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\FileRevisionBlob;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\DriveStoreRepository;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\FileRevisionStoreRepository;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\FileStoreRepository;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeReadRepository;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeStoreRepository;
use Vaulter\Support\NodeName;
use Vaulter\Support\TreeGuard;

/**
 * Copy a node into a destination (§2.4) — the locked destination must be a live
 * folder of the source's storage, and the root itself is never copied:
 *   - folder → deep-copy the whole subtree (new node rows, same shape);
 *   - file   → new File + new FileRevision(number=1) whose version↔blob edge
 *     references the SAME blob, so content-addressed dedup keeps ONE physical
 *     object — a copy costs a row, not bytes.
 *
 * used_bytes counts LIVE logical bytes, so a copy increments it by the copied
 * size even though the blob is shared (the quota models what the storage holds
 * logically, not the deduped physical footprint).
 *
 * Authorization (M2a / H.2) is enforced upstream at the HTTP controller
 * boundary (NodeController + AccessResolver); this Action stays pure.
 */
final readonly class CopyNodeAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private NodeReadRepository $nodes,
        private NodeStoreRepository $nodeStore,
        private FileStoreRepository $files,
        private FileRevisionStoreRepository $versions,
        private DriveStoreRepository $storageStore,
        private BlobStore $blobs,
        private VaulterDatabase $database,
        private TreeGuard $tree,
    ) {}

    public function execute(CopyNodeData $data): Node
    {
        $source = $data->node;
        // An explicit name is new input; the source name was validated when it was written.
        $name = $data->name === null ? $source->name : NodeName::normalize($data->name);
        $destParentId = $this->tree->destinationId(storage: $source->storage, into: $data->into);

        $this->tree->assertNotRoot(node: $source, operation: 'copy');

        try {
            return $this->database->transaction(function () use ($source, $destParentId, $name, $data): Node {
                $this->database->lockTreeShared($source->drive_id);

                // Freeze the source membership before inserting any copies, then lock
                // every source node with the destination in ascending id order.
                $sourceIds = array_values($this->nodes->subtree($source)->modelKeys());
                $locked = $this->tree->lock([...$sourceIds, $destParentId]);
                $current = $this->tree->locked($locked, $source->id);
                $destination = $this->tree->locked($locked, $destParentId);
                $resolvedName = $data->name === null ? $current->name : $name;
                if (!$this->tree->sameStorage($destination, $source->drive_id)) {
                    throw CrossStorageMoveException::between(fromStorageId: $source->drive_id, toStorageId: $destination->drive_id);
                }

                $this->tree->assertActiveFolder($destination);

                $exists = $this->nodes->siblingNameExists(
                    storage: $source->storage,
                    parentId: $destParentId,
                    name: $resolvedName,
                );

                if ($exists) {
                    throw NodeNameConflictException::forName(name: $resolvedName, parentId: $destParentId);
                }

                $addedBytes = 0;
                $copy = $this->copyNode(source: $current, parentId: $destParentId, name: $resolvedName, data: $data, addedBytes: $addedBytes, sourceIds: $sourceIds);

                if ($addedBytes > 0) {
                    $this->storageStore->reserveBytes(storage: $source->storage, delta: $addedBytes);
                }

                event(new NodeCopied(source: $current, copy: $copy, actorId: $data->actorId));

                return $copy;
            }, 3);
        } catch (CoreQuotaExceededException $e) {
            throw new QuotaExceededException($e->getMessage(), $e->getCode(), $e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Copy one node (recursing into a folder's children). $addedBytes accumulates
     * the live logical size the copy adds, for the used_bytes adjustment.
     *
     * @param list<int|string> $sourceIds
     */
    private function copyNode(Node $source, int|string $parentId, string $name, CopyNodeData $data, int &$addedBytes, array $sourceIds): Node
    {
        $copy = $this->nodeStore->create([
            'drive_id' => $source->drive_id,
            'parent_id' => $parentId,
            'kind' => $source->kind,
            'name' => $name,
            'mime_type' => $source->mime_type,
            'extension' => $source->extension,
            'size_bytes' => $source->size_bytes ?? 0,
            'is_pinned' => $source->is_pinned ?? false,
            'inherit_grants' => $source->inherit_grants ?? true,
            'shortcut_target_id' => $source->shortcut_target_id,
            'owner_id' => $data->actorId,
            'created_by' => $data->actorId,
        ]);

        if ($source->kind === NodeKind::File) {
            $this->copyFilePayload(source: $source, copy: $copy, data: $data);
            $addedBytes += $source->size_bytes ?? 0;
        }

        if ($source->kind === NodeKind::Folder) {
            foreach ($source->children()->whereIn('id', $sourceIds)->whereNull('trashed_at')->get() as $child) {
                $this->copyNode(source: $child, parentId: $copy->id, name: $child->name, data: $data, addedBytes: $addedBytes, sourceIds: $sourceIds);
            }
        }

        return $copy;
    }

    /**
     * Copy a file node's payload: a new File + first FileRevision that re-uses the
     * source head's blob(s) through NEW edges (§2.4 dedup). No bytes are staged or
     * committed — the blob already exists, we just add another reference.
     */
    private function copyFilePayload(Node $source, Node $copy, CopyNodeData $data): void
    {
        /** @var File|null $sourceFile */
        $sourceFile = $source->file()->first();

        if (!$sourceFile instanceof File) {
            return;
        }

        /** @var FileRevision|null $head */
        $head = $sourceFile->currentVersion()->first();

        if (!$head instanceof FileRevision) {
            return;
        }

        $file = $this->files->create([
            'node_id' => $copy->id,
            'mime_type' => $sourceFile->mime_type,
            'size_bytes' => $sourceFile->size_bytes,
            'revision_count' => 0,
        ]);

        $version = $this->versions->create([
            'file_id' => $file->id,
            'number' => 1,
            'blob_id' => $head->blob_id,
            'sha256' => $head->sha256,
            'size_bytes' => $head->size_bytes,
            'mime_type' => $head->mime_type,
            'original_name' => $head->original_name,
            'status' => 'committed',
            'created_by' => $data->actorId,
            'committed_at' => now(),
        ]);

        // Re-reference every blob the source head pointed at (data/manifest/chunk)
        // through fresh edges — dedup keeps the one physical object alive.
        foreach ($head->blobs as $blob) {
            $this->reattach(version: $version, blob: $blob);
        }

        $this->files->repointHead(
            file: $file,
            currentVersionId: $version->id,
            mimeType: $sourceFile->mime_type,
            sizeBytes: $sourceFile->size_bytes,
            versionNo: 1,
        );

        $this->nodeStore->update($copy, [
            'file_id' => $file->id,
            'current_version_id' => $version->id,
        ]);
    }

    private function reattach(FileRevision $version, Blob $blob): void
    {
        /** @var FileRevisionBlob $pivot */
        $pivot = $blob->getRelationValue('pivot');

        $this->blobs->attach($version, $blob, [
            'role' => $pivot->role,
            'ordinal' => $pivot->ordinal,
            'offset_bytes' => $pivot->offset_bytes,
            'length_bytes' => $pivot->length_bytes,
        ]);
    }
}
```

## packages/drive/src/Actions/CreateFolderAction.php

SHA256 6b8f7e3513e0f449f2bf1d55c6a7defb4d8d153ea85c4e5303f1b453fe13851d; bytes 2789.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Actions;

use Vaulter\Database\VaulterDatabase;
use Vaulter\Drive\Data\CreateDriveFolderData;
use Vaulter\Drive\Events\NodeCreated;
use Vaulter\Drive\Exceptions\CrossStorageMoveException;
use Vaulter\Enums\Drive\NodeKind;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Nodes\NodeNameConflictException;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeReadRepository;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeStoreRepository;
use Vaulter\Support\NodeName;
use Vaulter\Support\TreeGuard;

/**
 * Create a kind=folder node under a parent (or the storage root) — §2.2. The
 * parent row is locked and must be a live folder of the same storage; the
 * sibling-name conflict is surfaced deterministically (NodeNameConflictException)
 * rather than silently auto-renamed: Drive never invents a name behind the
 * caller's back.
 *
 * Authorization (M2a / H.2) is enforced UPSTREAM at the HTTP controller boundary
 * (NodeController::guardCreate → AccessResolver), so the Action stays pure: it
 * receives an already-authorized parent/storage and only does the row work.
 */
final readonly class CreateFolderAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private NodeReadRepository $nodes,
        private NodeStoreRepository $store,
        private VaulterDatabase $database,
        private TreeGuard $tree,
    ) {}

    public function execute(CreateDriveFolderData $data): Node
    {
        $name = NodeName::normalize($data->name);
        $parentId = $this->tree->destinationId(storage: $data->storage, into: $data->parent);

        return $this->database->transaction(function () use ($data, $name, $parentId): Node {
            $this->database->lockTreeShared($data->storage->id);

            $parent = $this->tree->locked($this->tree->lock([$parentId]), $parentId);
            if (!$this->tree->sameStorage($parent, $data->storage->id)) {
                throw CrossStorageMoveException::between(fromStorageId: $data->storage->id, toStorageId: $parent->drive_id);
            }

            $this->tree->assertActiveFolder($parent);

            if ($this->nodes->siblingNameExists(storage: $data->storage, parentId: $parentId, name: $name)) {
                throw NodeNameConflictException::forName(name: $name, parentId: $parentId);
            }

            $node = $this->store->create([
                'drive_id' => $data->storage->id,
                'parent_id' => $parentId,
                'kind' => NodeKind::Folder,
                'name' => $name,
                'size_bytes' => 0,
                'owner_id' => $data->actorId,
                'created_by' => $data->actorId,
            ]);

            event(new NodeCreated(node: $node, actorId: $data->actorId));

            return $node;
        });
    }
}
```

## packages/drive/src/Actions/ForceDeleteNodeAction.php

SHA256 ae8e1335c27d783a3c9df0df667439932107f70599d3b85a5275c70eb10c8aa0; bytes 4290.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Actions;

use Vaulter\Contracts\Cas\BlobStore;
use Vaulter\Database\VaulterDatabase;
use Vaulter\Drive\Events\NodeForceDeleted;
use Vaulter\Enums\Drive\NodeKind;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Nodes\NodeNotTrashedException;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\File;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\FileRevision;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\FileRevisionBlob;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\DriveStoreRepository;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeReadRepository;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeStoreRepository;
use Vaulter\Support\TreeGuard;

/**
 * Permanently soft-delete a trashed node and its subtree (§2.10 stage 2). Only a
 * node already in the trash qualifies (a live node goes through the trash first)
 * and the root never does; the subtree is read under the storage tree lock. The
 * order matters and is the GC contract (§2.3 / §2.4):
 *   1. detach every version↔blob edge in the subtree — the edge IS the liveness
 *      truth (H.3), so dropping it makes the blob GC-eligible; the bytes are
 *      NEVER deleted here (M1b's two-phase GC reclaims them);
 *   2. soft-delete (deleted_at) the node rows in one bulk UPDATE;
 *   3. decrement used_bytes by the freed LIVE size (§1.5 — trash kept the bytes;
 *      forceDelete is where the quota is actually reclaimed).
 *
 * Authorization (M2a / H.2) is enforced upstream at the HTTP controller
 * boundary (NodeController + AccessResolver); this Action stays pure.
 */
final readonly class ForceDeleteNodeAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private NodeReadRepository $nodes,
        private NodeStoreRepository $store,
        private DriveStoreRepository $storageStore,
        private BlobStore $blobs,
        private VaulterDatabase $database,
        private TreeGuard $tree,
    ) {}

    public function execute(Node $node, int|string|null $actorId = null): void
    {
        $storage = $node->storage;

        $this->database->transaction(function () use ($node, $storage, $actorId): void {
            $this->database->lockTree($node->drive_id);

            $current = $this->tree->sync($node, $this->tree->locked($this->tree->lock([$node->id]), $node->id));

            $this->tree->assertNotRoot(node: $current, operation: 'delete');

            if ($current->trashed_at === null) {
                throw NodeNotTrashedException::forNode($current);
            }

            $subtree = $this->nodes->subtree($current);
            $ids = $subtree->modelKeys();
            $freedBytes = 0;

            foreach ($subtree as $member) {
                if ($member->kind !== NodeKind::File) {
                    continue;
                }

                $freedBytes += $this->detachFilePayload($member);
            }

            $this->store->softDeleteSubtree(collect($ids));

            if ($freedBytes > 0) {
                $this->storageStore->adjustUsedBytes(storage: $storage, delta: -$freedBytes);
            }

            event(new NodeForceDeleted(
                storageId: $current->drive_id,
                nodeIds: array_values($ids),
                freedBytes: $freedBytes,
                actorId: $actorId,
            ));
        });
    }

    /**
     * Detach every blob edge of every version of a file node and return its live
     * head size (the bytes the storage stops accounting for). Detaching only drops
     * the reference — the physical object is reclaimed later by GC.
     */
    private function detachFilePayload(Node $node): int
    {
        /** @var File|null $file */
        $file = $node->file()->first();

        if (!$file instanceof File) {
            return 0;
        }

        foreach ($file->versions()->get() as $version) {
            $this->detachVersionEdges($version);
        }

        return $node->size_bytes;
    }

    private function detachVersionEdges(FileRevision $version): void
    {
        foreach ($version->blobs as $blob) {
            /** @var FileRevisionBlob $pivot */
            $pivot = $blob->getRelationValue('pivot');

            $this->blobs->detach(
                version: $version,
                blob: $blob,
                role: $pivot->role,
                ordinal: $pivot->ordinal,
            );
        }
    }
}
```

## packages/drive/src/Actions/MoveNodeAction.php

SHA256 56e3ff733913bd604c20fad3ebb230995df9332e493cd2a21672665d323f15a0; bytes 4811.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Actions;

use Vaulter\Contracts\Observability\MetricsRecorder;
use Vaulter\Database\VaulterDatabase;
use Vaulter\Drive\Data\MoveNodeData;
use Vaulter\Drive\Events\NodeMoved;
use Vaulter\Drive\Exceptions\CrossStorageMoveException;
use Vaulter\Drive\Exceptions\CycleException;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Nodes\NodeNameConflictException;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeReadRepository;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeStoreRepository;
use Vaulter\Support\Identity;
use Vaulter\Support\TreeGuard;

/**
 * Re-parent a node within its storage tree — the §2.2 / H.4 single parent_id
 * UPDATE. Every guard runs inside the transaction, after the storage tree lock and
 * the row locks on the node and its destination:
 *   1. the root never moves;
 *   2. the destination is a live folder of the same storage (no destination = root);
 *   3. cycle — the destination must not be the node itself or one of its own
 *      descendants (checked via the bounded subtree, NOT whereHas('descendants'));
 *   4. sibling-name conflict at the destination.
 *
 * The tree lock is what makes the cycle check sound: row locks on the node and the
 * destination alone do not cover the ancestor chain, so two moves over disjoint rows
 * (A into B's child, B into A's child) could both pass and close a loop.
 *
 * Authorization (M2a / H.2) is enforced upstream at the HTTP controller
 * boundary (NodeController + AccessResolver); this Action stays pure.
 */
final readonly class MoveNodeAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private NodeReadRepository $nodes,
        private NodeStoreRepository $store,
        private MetricsRecorder $metrics,
        private VaulterDatabase $database,
        private TreeGuard $tree,
    ) {}

    public function execute(MoveNodeData $data): Node
    {
        $node = $data->node;
        $intoId = $this->tree->destinationId(storage: $node->storage, into: $data->into);

        return $this->database->transaction(function () use ($node, $intoId, $data): Node {
            $this->database->lockTree($node->drive_id);

            $locked = $this->tree->lock([$node->id, $intoId]);
            $current = $this->tree->sync($node, $this->tree->locked($locked, $node->id));
            $into = $this->tree->locked($locked, $intoId);

            $this->tree->assertNotRoot(node: $current, operation: 'move');
            if (!$this->tree->sameStorage($into, $current->drive_id)) {
                throw CrossStorageMoveException::between(fromStorageId: $current->drive_id, toStorageId: $into->drive_id);
            }

            $this->tree->assertActiveFolder($into);
            $this->assertNoCycle(node: $current, into: $into);

            $fromParentId = $current->parent_id;
            $toParentId = $into->id;

            if (Identity::stringify($fromParentId) === Identity::stringify($toParentId)) {
                return $current;
            }

            $this->assertNameAvailable(node: $current, into: $into);

            $moved = $this->store->move(node: $current, parentId: $toParentId);

            event(new NodeMoved(
                node: $moved,
                fromParentId: $fromParentId,
                toParentId: $toParentId,
                actorId: $data->actorId,
            ));

            return $moved;
        });
    }

    /**
     * The cycle guard (H.4): a node cannot move into itself nor any node in its
     * own subtree. We materialise the bounded subtree once and test membership —
     * never a recursive correlated aggregate in the request path.
     */
    private function assertNoCycle(Node $node, Node $into): void
    {
        if (Identity::stringify($into->id) === Identity::stringify($node->id)) {
            throw CycleException::forMove(nodeId: $node->id, intoId: $into->id);
        }

        $descendantIds = array_map(
            Identity::stringify(...),
            $this->nodes->subtree($node)->modelKeys(),
        );

        $this->metrics->histogram(
            name: 'vaulter_subtree_nodes_touched',
            value: count($descendantIds),
            labels: ['operation' => 'subtree_mutate'],
        );

        if (in_array(Identity::stringify($into->id), $descendantIds, strict: true)) {
            throw CycleException::forMove(nodeId: $node->id, intoId: $into->id);
        }
    }

    private function assertNameAvailable(Node $node, Node $into): void
    {
        $exists = $this->nodes->siblingNameExists(
            storage: $node->storage,
            parentId: $into->id,
            name: $node->name,
            ignoreId: $node->id,
        );

        if ($exists) {
            throw NodeNameConflictException::forName(name: $node->name, parentId: $into->id);
        }
    }
}
```

## packages/drive/src/Actions/RenameNodeAction.php

SHA256 cad2bd429494f634b16f7a83ae4022b50ebe6526176147b6d9851a34da5e5033; bytes 2676.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Actions;

use Vaulter\Database\VaulterDatabase;
use Vaulter\Drive\Data\RenameNodeData;
use Vaulter\Drive\Events\NodeRenamed;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Nodes\NodeNameConflictException;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeReadRepository;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeStoreRepository;
use Vaulter\Support\NodeName;
use Vaulter\Support\TreeGuard;

/**
 * Rename a node in place (§2.2), subject to the sibling-name conflict check at
 * its current parent (the node itself is excluded from the check). The root is
 * never renamed; the check runs against the locked row.
 *
 * Authorization (M2a / H.2) is enforced upstream at the HTTP controller
 * boundary (NodeController + AccessResolver); this Action stays pure.
 */
final readonly class RenameNodeAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private NodeReadRepository $nodes,
        private NodeStoreRepository $store,
        private VaulterDatabase $database,
        private TreeGuard $tree,
    ) {}

    public function execute(RenameNodeData $data): Node
    {
        $node = $data->node;
        $name = NodeName::normalize($data->name);

        return $this->database->transaction(function () use ($node, $name, $data): Node {
            $this->database->lockTreeShared($node->drive_id);
            $current = $this->tree->sync($node, $this->tree->locked($this->tree->lock([$node->id]), $node->id));

            // The parent row is locked too, so a create into the same folder cannot claim
            // the new name between the sibling check and the UPDATE. Locking upward from
            // the node cannot cycle: the tree is acyclic and moves are excluded.
            $this->tree->lock([$current->parent_id]);
            $this->tree->assertNotRoot(node: $current, operation: 'rename');

            $fromName = $current->name;

            if ($fromName === $name) {
                return $current;
            }

            $exists = $this->nodes->siblingNameExists(
                storage: $current->storage,
                parentId: $current->parent_id,
                name: $name,
                ignoreId: $current->id,
            );

            if ($exists) {
                throw NodeNameConflictException::forName(name: $name, parentId: $current->parent_id);
            }

            $renamed = $this->store->rename(node: $current, name: $name);

            event(new NodeRenamed(
                node: $renamed,
                fromName: $fromName,
                toName: $name,
                actorId: $data->actorId,
            ));

            return $renamed;
        });
    }
}
```

## packages/drive/src/Actions/RestoreNodeAction.php

SHA256 773cf18bb6589679a07b56f5a8a718700dd50de2d5a95f59e3e937994b23a7f6; bytes 4846.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Actions;

use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Vaulter\Database\VaulterDatabase;
use Vaulter\Drive\Events\NodeRestored;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Nodes\InvalidDestinationException;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Nodes\NodeNameConflictException;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Nodes\NodeNotTrashedException;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeReadRepository;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeStoreRepository;
use Vaulter\Support\Identity;
use Vaulter\Support\TreeGuard;

/**
 * Restore a trashed node and its subtree (§2.10). Clears the trashed triplet
 * across the bounded subtree in one bulk UPDATE. Runs under the storage tree lock
 * (it re-parents) with the node, its original parent and the root locked, and only
 * accepts a node that is actually in the trash. Two deterministic destination
 * rules (§2.10 restore-collision):
 *   - if the original parent is gone (deleted / itself trashed / no longer a
 *     folder), re-home the node to the storage root rather than dangling it;
 *   - if a LIVE sibling now owns the node's name at the resolved destination,
 *     throw NodeNameConflictException — the caller renames then retries.
 *
 * Authorization (M2a / H.2) is enforced upstream at the HTTP controller
 * boundary (NodeController + AccessResolver); this Action stays pure.
 */
final readonly class RestoreNodeAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private NodeReadRepository $nodes,
        private NodeStoreRepository $store,
        private VaulterDatabase $database,
        private TreeGuard $tree,
    ) {}

    public function execute(Node $node, int|string|null $actorId = null): Node
    {
        $rootId = $this->tree->destinationId(storage: $node->storage, into: null);

        return $this->database->transaction(function () use ($node, $rootId, $actorId): Node {
            $this->database->lockTree($node->drive_id);

            $current = $this->tree->sync($node, $this->tree->locked($this->tree->lock([$node->id, $rootId]), $node->id));

            if ($current->trashed_at === null) {
                throw NodeNotTrashedException::forNode($current);
            }

            // The original parent is read from the locked row, not the caller's model.
            // Locking it after the node is safe: the tree lock excludes every other
            // operation that holds more than one node row.
            $originalParentId = $current->trashed_from_parent_id ?? $current->parent_id;
            $locked = $this->tree->lock([$originalParentId]);
            $destinationParentId = $this->resolveDestinationParent(node: $current, locked: $locked, rootId: $rootId);

            if ($this->liveSiblingOwnsName(node: $current, parentId: $destinationParentId)) {
                throw NodeNameConflictException::forName(name: $current->name, parentId: $destinationParentId);
            }

            $ids = $this->nodes->subtree($current)->modelKeys();

            // Re-home the subtree root first (so the cleared triplet lands on a
            // node already hung at its restored destination), then clear trash.
            if (Identity::stringify($current->parent_id) !== Identity::stringify($destinationParentId)) {
                $this->store->move(node: $current, parentId: $destinationParentId);
            }

            $this->store->restoreSubtree(collect($ids));

            $fresh = $current->refresh();

            event(new NodeRestored(node: $fresh, actorId: $actorId));

            return $fresh;
        });
    }

    /**
     * The destination parent for the restored node: its recorded original parent
     * when that row is still a live folder of the same storage, else the root. The
     * row was locked with the node, so it cannot be trashed or moved meanwhile.
     *
     * @param Collection<string, Node> $locked
     */
    private function resolveDestinationParent(Node $node, Collection $locked, int|string $rootId): int|string
    {
        $originalParentId = $node->trashed_from_parent_id ?? $node->parent_id;

        if ($originalParentId === null) {
            return $rootId;
        }

        $parent = $locked->get(Identity::stringify($originalParentId));

        if (!$parent instanceof Node || !$this->tree->sameStorage($parent, $node->drive_id)) {
            return $rootId;
        }

        try {
            $this->tree->assertActiveFolder($parent);
        } catch (InvalidDestinationException) {
            return $rootId;
        }

        return $parent->id;
    }

    private function liveSiblingOwnsName(Node $node, int|string $parentId): bool
    {
        return $this->nodes->siblingNameExists(
            storage: $node->storage,
            parentId: $parentId,
            name: $node->name,
            ignoreId: $node->id,
        );
    }
}
```

SHA256 a37cd2770819aff23d424bdc6cd23b6b9f6fcff4a7bef3146e223388c9713956; bytes 2644.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Actions;

use Vaulter\Database\VaulterDatabase;
use Vaulter\Drive\Events\NodeTrashed;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Nodes\InvalidDestinationException;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeReadRepository;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeStoreRepository;
use Vaulter\Support\TreeGuard;

/**
 * Soft-trash a node and its whole subtree atomically (§2.10 / D17) under the storage
 * tree lock. The root is never trashed and a node already in the trash is rejected. The trashed
 * triplet (trashed_at, trashed_by, and trashed_from_parent_id on the root) is
 * stamped across the bounded subtree in one bulk UPDATE; the sibling-unique index
 * excludes trashed rows so the name frees up for a new sibling.
 *
 * used_bytes is NOT decremented — trashed bytes still occupy storage until
 * forceDelete (§1.5: quota counts what is physically retained, and a restore must
 * bring the bytes back). The decrement happens only in ForceDeleteNodeAction.
 *
 * Authorization (M2a / H.2) is enforced upstream at the HTTP controller
 * boundary (NodeController + AccessResolver); this Action stays pure.
 */
final readonly class TrashNodeAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private NodeReadRepository $nodes,
        private NodeStoreRepository $store,
        private VaulterDatabase $database,
        private TreeGuard $tree,
    ) {}

    public function execute(Node $node, int|string|null $actorId = null): Node
    {
        return $this->database->transaction(function () use ($node, $actorId): Node {
            // The subtree UPDATE locks every descendant row after the node row, in no
            // particular id order; the tree lock keeps that from crossing a concurrent
            // move or restore that holds a descendant and waits for an ancestor.
            $this->database->lockTree($node->drive_id);

            $current = $this->tree->sync($node, $this->tree->locked($this->tree->lock([$node->id]), $node->id));

            $this->tree->assertNotRoot(node: $current, operation: 'trash');

            if ($current->trashed_at !== null) {
                throw InvalidDestinationException::trashed($current);
            }

            $ids = $this->nodes->subtree($current)->modelKeys();

            $this->store->trashSubtree(
                ids: collect($ids),
                root: $current,
                actorId: $actorId,
                at: now(),
            );

            $fresh = $current->refresh();

            event(new NodeTrashed(node: $fresh, actorId: $actorId));

            return $fresh;
        });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Actions;

use LogicException;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Cas\BlobStore;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Cas\ContentStore;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Observability\MetricsRecorder;
use Vaulter\Database\VaulterDatabase;
use Vaulter\Drive\Data\UploadFileData;
use Vaulter\Drive\Events\FileUploaded;
use Vaulter\Drive\Events\NodeVersionCommitted;
use Vaulter\Drive\Exceptions\CrossStorageMoveException;
use Vaulter\Drive\Exceptions\QuotaExceededException;
use Vaulter\Enums\Drive\NodeKind;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Drive\QuotaExceededException as CoreQuotaExceededException;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Nodes\NodeNameConflictException;
use Vaulter\Models\Cas\Blob;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\File;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\FileRevision;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\DriveStoreRepository;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\FileRevisionStoreRepository;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\FileStoreRepository;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeReadRepository;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeStoreRepository;
use Vaulter\Support\Config;
use Vaulter\Support\LoadTier;
use Vaulter\Support\NodeName;
use Vaulter\Support\TreeGuard;
use Vaulter\ValueObjects\Cas\BlobScope;

/**
 * Commit an upload into the Drive (§2.4 commit flow): stage → quota → BlobStore.commitStaged
 * (content-addressed dedup) → File + FileRevision(number) + version↔blob edge
 * → file node (current_revision_id, mime, size, extension).
 *
 * Quota (§1.5 eager): the incoming size is checked against the storage's
 * quota_bytes by a conditional UPDATE WITHIN the transaction, before CAS promotion.
 * Preparation happens once outside SQL so transaction retries reuse the same bytes.
 *
 * Two paths share one Action:
 *   - new file → create Node(kind=file) + File + FileRevision(number=1);
 *   - new version (upload onto an existing file node) → bump number, repoint
 *     current_revision_id, mark the prior head superseded, and adjust used_bytes by
 *     the SIZE DELTA (new size − previous head size), not the full size.
 *
 * Authorization (M2a / H.2) is enforced upstream at the HTTP controller
 * boundary (NodeController + AccessResolver); this Action stays pure.
 */
final readonly class UploadFileAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private BlobStore $blobs,
        private ContentStore $content,
        private FileStoreRepository $files,
        private FileRevisionStoreRepository $versions,
        private NodeStoreRepository $nodeStore,
        private NodeReadRepository $nodeRead,
        private DriveStoreRepository $storageStore,
        private MetricsRecorder $metrics,
        private VaulterDatabase $database,
        private TreeGuard $tree,
    ) {}

    public function execute(UploadFileData $data): Node
    {
        return $this->metrics->timing(
            name: 'vaulter_upload_chunk_duration_seconds',
            operation: fn (): Node => $this->executeUpload($data),
            labels: [
                'protocol' => 'single',
                'tier' => LoadTier::label(),
            ],
        );
    }

    private function executeUpload(UploadFileData $data): Node
    {
        $name = $data->isNewVersion() ? null : NodeName::normalize($data->resolvedName());
        $parentId = $data->isNewVersion() ? null : $this->tree->destinationId(storage: $data->storage, into: $data->into);
        $staged = $this->content->stage($data->stream);

        try {
            // Revision deltas must use the locked head; a stale caller cannot reject them.
            if (!$data->isNewVersion()) {
                $this->assertWithinQuota(data: $data, delta: $staged->sizeBytes());
            }

            $node = $this->database->transaction(function () use ($data, $staged, $name, $parentId): Node {
                // Lock order: drive → nodes → file → quota → CAS, so concurrent writers never deadlock.
                $this->database->lockTreeShared($data->storage->id);

                if ($name !== null && $parentId !== null) {
                    $this->assertDestination(data: $data, parentId: $parentId, name: $name);
                }

                $target = $data->targetNode;
                $file = null;
                $previousHead = null;

                if ($target instanceof Node) {
                    $this->tree->sync($target, $this->tree->locked($this->tree->lock([$target->id]), $target->id));
                    /** @var File $currentFile */
                    $currentFile = $target->file()->firstOrFail();
                    $file = $this->files->lockForUpdate($currentFile);
                    $previousHead = $file->currentVersion()->first();
                }

                $size = $staged->sizeBytes();
                $delta = $size - ($previousHead->size_bytes ?? 0);

                if ($delta > 0) {
                    $this->storageStore->reserveBytes(storage: $data->storage, delta: $delta);
                } elseif ($delta < 0) {
                    $this->storageStore->adjustUsedBytes(storage: $data->storage, delta: $delta);
                }

                $storageId = $data->storage->getKey();
                if (!is_int($storageId) && !is_string($storageId)) {
                    throw new LogicException('An upload requires a persisted storage identifier.');
                }

                $blob = $this->blobs->commitStaged(
                    staged: $staged,
                    scope: BlobScope::forUpload(
                        Config::dedupScope(),
                        $data->storage->tenant_id === null ? null : (string) $data->storage->tenant_id,
                        (string) $storageId,
                    ),
                    disk: $data->storage->disk,
                );

                return $file instanceof File
                    ? $this->commitNewVersion(data: $data, file: $file, previousHead: $previousHead, blob: $blob, size: $size)
                    : $this->commitNewFile(data: $data, blob: $blob, size: $size, name: $name ?? '', parentId: $parentId ?? throw new LogicException('An upload requires a destination.'));
            }, 3);

            $this->metrics->counter(
                name: 'vaulter_upload_bytes_total',
                amount: $staged->sizeBytes(),
                labels: ['protocol' => 'single'],
            );

            return $node;
        } catch (CoreQuotaExceededException $e) {
            throw $e instanceof QuotaExceededException ? $e : new QuotaExceededException($e->getMessage(), $e->getCode(), $e);
        } finally {
            $staged->discard();
        }
    }

    /**
     * New-file path (§2.4): node(kind=file) → file → number=1 → edge → repoint.
     */
    private function commitNewFile(UploadFileData $data, Blob $blob, int $size, string $name, int|string $parentId): Node
    {
        $node = $this->nodeStore->create([
            'drive_id' => $data->storage->id,
            'parent_id' => $parentId,
            'kind' => NodeKind::File,
            'name' => $name,
            'mime_type' => $data->mimeType,
            'extension' => $this->extension($data->originalName),
            'size_bytes' => $size,
            'owner_id' => $data->actorId,
            'created_by' => $data->actorId,
        ]);

        $file = $this->files->create([
            'node_id' => $node->id,
            'mime_type' => $data->mimeType,
            'size_bytes' => $size,
            'revision_count' => 0,
        ]);

        $version = $this->makeVersion(data: $data, file: $file, blob: $blob, size: $size, versionNo: 1);

        $this->blobs->attach($version, $blob);

        $this->files->repointHead(
            file: $file,
            currentVersionId: $version->id,
            mimeType: $data->mimeType,
            sizeBytes: $size,
            versionNo: $version->number,
        );

        $this->nodeStore->update($node, [
            'file_id' => $file->id,
            'current_version_id' => $version->id,
        ]);

        event(new FileUploaded(node: $node->refresh(), file: $file, version: $version, actorId: $data->actorId));

        return $node;
    }

    /**
     * New-version path (§2.4): bump number, new version + edge against the
     * (deduped) blob, mark the prior head superseded, repoint file + node heads.
     */
    private function commitNewVersion(UploadFileData $data, File $file, ?FileRevision $previousHead, Blob $blob, int $size): Node
    {
        $node = $data->targetNode;

        if (!$node instanceof Node) {
            // Defensive: isNewVersion() already guaranteed this; keeps PHPStan honest.
            throw new LogicException('[Vaulter] A new-version upload requires a target node.');
        }

        $version = $this->makeVersion(
            data: $data,
            file: $file,
            blob: $blob,
            size: $size,
            versionNo: $file->revision_count + 1,
        );

        $this->blobs->attach($version, $blob);

        if ($previousHead instanceof FileRevision) {
            $this->versions->markSuperseded($previousHead);
        }

        $this->files->repointHead(
            file: $file,
            currentVersionId: $version->id,
            mimeType: $data->mimeType ?? $file->mime_type,
            sizeBytes: $size,
            versionNo: $version->number,
        );

        $this->nodeStore->repointHead(
            node: $node,
            currentVersionId: $version->id,
            mimeType: $data->mimeType ?? $node->mime_type,
            extension: $node->extension,
            sizeBytes: $size,
        );

        event(new NodeVersionCommitted(
            node: $node->refresh(),
            file: $file,
            version: $version,
            versionNo: $version->number,
            actorId: $data->actorId,
        ));

        return $node;
    }

    private function makeVersion(
        UploadFileData $data,
        File $file,
        Blob $blob,
        int $size,
        int $versionNo,
    ): FileRevision {
        return $this->versions->create([
            'file_id' => $file->getKey(),
            'number' => $versionNo,
            'blob_id' => $blob->getKey(),
            'sha256' => $blob->sha256,
            'size_bytes' => $size,
            'mime_type' => $data->mimeType,
            'original_name' => $data->originalName,
            'status' => 'committed',
            'created_by' => $data->actorId,
            'committed_at' => now(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Reject the upload BEFORE committing bytes when it would push used_bytes past
     * quota_bytes (§1.5). A null quota is unlimited; a non-positive delta (a
     * smaller new version) never trips the check.
     */
    private function assertWithinQuota(UploadFileData $data, int $delta): void
    {
        $quota = $data->storage->quota_bytes;

        if ($quota === null || $delta <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        if ($data->storage->used_bytes + $delta > $quota) {
            throw QuotaExceededException::forStorage(
                storageId: $data->storage->id,
                quotaBytes: $quota,
                usedBytes: $data->storage->used_bytes,
                incomingBytes: $delta,
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * The destination folder is locked before the bytes are committed, so it cannot
     * be trashed or replaced by a file between the check and the insert.
     */
    private function assertDestination(UploadFileData $data, int|string $parentId, string $name): void
    {
        $parent = $this->tree->locked($this->tree->lock([$parentId]), $parentId);
        if (!$this->tree->sameStorage($parent, $data->storage->id)) {
            throw CrossStorageMoveException::between(fromStorageId: $data->storage->id, toStorageId: $parent->drive_id);
        }

        $this->tree->assertActiveFolder($parent);

        if ($this->nodeRead->siblingNameExists(storage: $data->storage, parentId: $parentId, name: $name)) {
            throw NodeNameConflictException::forName(name: $name, parentId: $parentId);
        }
    }

    private function extension(string $name): ?string
    {
        $ext = pathinfo($name, PATHINFO_EXTENSION);

        return $ext === '' ? null : mb_strtolower($ext);
    }
}
```

## packages/drive/src/Actions/Uploads/CommitUploadAction.php

SHA256 ed8b4b5e1edf4342f02b2bd86d8e8aaf2fc86588c762ad7a71e4f54fe04b3a8c; bytes 7479.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Uploads;

use RuntimeException;
use Vaulter\Database\VaulterDatabase;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\UploadFileAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Data\UploadFileData;
use Vaulter\Drive\Exceptions\UploadContentMismatchException;
use Vaulter\Drive\Models\Uploads\UploadSession;
use Vaulter\Drive\Repositories\Uploads\UploadSessionStoreRepository;
use Vaulter\Drive\Support\Uploads\MagicByteSniffer;
use Vaulter\Drive\Support\Uploads\StagedUpload;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Drive;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\DriveReadRepository;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeReadRepository;

/**
 * Assemble→commit for a resumable upload (§2.8 / D16 / M3a / H.3). This is the ONE
 * place the staged bytes of a tus / S3-multipart session cross into the Drive, and
 * it does so through the SAME race-free path a one-shot upload uses:
 *
 *   staged temp → UploadFileData → UploadFileAction → BlobStore.commitStaged
 *
 * so dedup + the race-free state machine + ref accounting + quota all apply, and the
 * sha256 is RECOMPUTED server-side from the assembled staged file inside
 * BlobStore.commitStaged (the client's expected_sha256 / the S3 multipart ETag is NEVER
 * the content address — H.3). The session's target shapes UploadFileData:
 *   - new file    → a Node(kind=file) under target_parent (null = root);
 *   - new version → a new version of node_id (number bumps, head repoints).
 *
 * On success the session is marked Committed with assembled_blob_id, and the staged
 * temp is discarded (commit-or-abort cleanup, H.3). The whole thing is one outer
 * transaction so a session is never half-committed.
 */
final readonly class CommitUploadAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private UploadFileAction $uploadFile,
        private NodeReadRepository $nodes,
        private DriveReadRepository $storages,
        private UploadSessionStoreRepository $sessions,
        private StagedUpload $staged,
        private MagicByteSniffer $sniffer,
        private VaulterDatabase $database,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Commit the assembled bytes of a session into the Drive and finalise the
     * session. Returns the created/updated file node.
     */
    public function execute(UploadSession $session): Node
    {
        $stream = $this->staged->readStream($session);

        if (!is_resource($stream)) {
            throw new RuntimeException(
                "Cannot commit upload session [{$session->upload_id}]: no staged bytes are present.",
            );
        }

        $this->assertContentMatchesDeclaredMime($session);

        try {
            $node = $this->database->transaction(function () use ($session, $stream): Node {
                $committed = $this->uploadFile->execute($this->dataFor(session: $session, stream: $stream));

                // current_revision_id is the head pointer; the version's blob_id is the
                // assembled blob the bytes deduped into (H.3 — set from the committed
                // version, never the client claim).
                $blobId = $this->assembledBlobId($committed);

                if ($blobId !== null) {
                    $this->sessions->markCommitted(session: $session, assembledBlobId: $blobId);
                }

                return $committed;
            });
        } finally {
            // $stream is guaranteed a live resource here (guarded above, never closed
            // inside the try) — close it once on both the success and throw paths.
            fclose($stream);
        }

        // Commit-or-abort cleanup (H.3): the staged temp is reclaimed once the bytes
        // are durable in the CAS. Done OUTSIDE the transaction so a disk-delete hiccup
        // never rolls back a committed file.
        $this->staged->discard($session);

        return $node;
    }

    /**
     * Reject a commit whose assembled bytes contradict the declared mime (§2.8 /
     * F-P1.4-11). Sniffed on a SEPARATE staged stream so the commit stream stays at
     * its start. A concrete contradiction (declared image/png, magic bytes ZIP)
     * fails the commit before any blob is written.
     */
    private function assertContentMatchesDeclaredMime(UploadSession $session): void
    {
        $sniff = $this->staged->readStream($session);

        if (!is_resource($sniff)) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            $matches = $this->sniffer->matches($sniff, $session->mime_type);
        } finally {
            fclose($sniff);
        }

        if (!$matches) {
            throw UploadContentMismatchException::forSession(
                $session->upload_id,
                (string) $session->mime_type,
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * Build the UploadFileData for the session's target shape (§2.8). The stream is
     * the assembled staged temp; the Action stages + re-hashes it.
     *
     * @param resource $stream
     */
    private function dataFor(UploadSession $session, mixed $stream): UploadFileData
    {
        $storage = $this->storageOf($session);

        if ($session->isNewVersion()) {
            return new UploadFileData(
                storage: $storage,
                stream: $stream,
                originalName: $session->target_name ?? $this->targetNodeName($session) ?? 'upload.bin',
                mimeType: $session->mime_type,
                targetNode: $this->targetNode($session),
                actorId: $session->created_by,
            );
        }

        return new UploadFileData(
            storage: $storage,
            stream: $stream,
            originalName: $session->target_name ?? 'upload.bin',
            mimeType: $session->mime_type,
            into: $this->targetParent($session),
            name: $session->target_name,
            actorId: $session->created_by,
        );
    }

    /**
     * The session's storage, loaded non-null (a session always belongs to a storage
     * via FK cascade — a missing one is a corrupt state, fail loud rather than
     * commit into the void).
     */
    private function storageOf(UploadSession $session): Drive
    {
        $storage = $this->storages->find($session->drive_id);

        if (!$storage instanceof Drive) {
            throw new RuntimeException(
                "Cannot commit upload session [{$session->upload_id}]: its storage [{$session->drive_id}] is missing.",
            );
        }

        return $storage;
    }

    private function targetParent(UploadSession $session): ?Node
    {
        if ($session->target_parent_id === null) {
            return null;
        }

        return $this->nodes->find($session->target_parent_id);
    }

    private function targetNode(UploadSession $session): ?Node
    {
        if ($session->target_node_id === null) {
            return null;
        }

        return $this->nodes->find($session->target_node_id);
    }

    private function targetNodeName(UploadSession $session): ?string
    {
        return $this->targetNode($session)?->name;
    }

    /**
     * The assembled blob id from the committed file node's head version (§2.8). Read
     * from the persisted version row so it reflects the deduped blob the CAS chose,
     * not anything the client supplied.
     */
    private function assembledBlobId(Node $node): int|string|null
    {
        $version = $node->currentVersion()->first();

        return $version?->blob_id;
    }
}
```

## packages/drive/src/Data/UploadFileData.php

SHA256 5186c41cd562bde0a225b9a12eadcfb1faa7c1bef0030a21218858ee06d8f261; bytes 1688.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Data;

use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Drive;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node;

/**
 * Command for UploadFileAction (§2.4 commit flow). Carries an already-normalised,
 * seekable byte stream plus the upload metadata — the StreamInterface / SplFileInfo
 * / UploadedFile ergonomics are normalised to a plain resource at the facade
 * (DriveContext::upload) so this command stays free of HTTP/PSR types and the
 * Action receives only bytes + intent.
 *
 * Two target shapes share one command:
 *   - new file  → $into set (or null = storage root) + $name; $targetNode null;
 *   - new version → $targetNode set (the existing kind=file node); $into/$name
 *     are ignored (the node keeps its place and name).
 */
final readonly class UploadFileData
{
    /**
     * @param resource $stream a seekable byte stream the BlobStore can stage
     */
    public function __construct(
        public Drive $storage,
        public mixed $stream,
        public string $originalName,
        public ?string $mimeType = null,
        public ?Node $into = null,
        public ?string $name = null,
        public ?Node $targetNode = null,
        public int|string|null $actorId = null,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Whether this upload commits a new version onto an existing file node rather
     * than creating a brand-new file.
     */
    public function isNewVersion(): bool
    {
        return $this->targetNode !== null;
    }

    /**
     * The stored node name — the explicit override, else the original upload name.
     */
    public function resolvedName(): string
    {
        return $this->name ?? $this->originalName;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Data\Uploads;

use Vaulter\Drive\Enums\Uploads\UploadProtocol;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Drive;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node;

/**
 * Command for UploadSessionManager::initiate (§2.8 / D16 / M3a): everything needed
 * to open a resumable session, free of HTTP/PSR types (the controller resolves the
 * route-bound storage / target node and decodes the tus metadata before building
 * this).
 *
 * Two target shapes share one command (mirrors UploadFileData):
 *   - new file    → $targetParent set (or null = storage root) + $targetName;
 *     $targetNode null;
 *   - new version → $targetNode set (the existing kind=file node); $targetParent /
 *     $targetName are ignored.
 *
 * The client may DECLARE $expectedSha256 / $totalSizeBytes, but the assembled bytes
 * are always re-hashed server-side at commit (H.3) — these are integrity hints, not
 * the content address.
 *
 * @property array<string, string> $metadata the decoded tus Upload-Metadata
 */
final readonly class UploadInitData
{
    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $metadata
     */
    public function __construct(
        public Drive $storage,
        public UploadProtocol $protocol,
        public ?Node $targetParent = null,
        public ?string $targetName = null,
        public ?Node $targetNode = null,
        public ?string $expectedSha256 = null,
        public ?int $totalSizeBytes = null,
        public ?string $mimeType = null,
        public array $metadata = [],
        public int|string|null $actorId = null,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Whether this session commits a new version onto an existing file node rather
     * than creating a brand-new file.
     */
    public function isNewVersion(): bool
    {
        return $this->targetNode !== null;
    }
}
```

## packages/drive/src/DriveContext.php

SHA256 c3b912413c8f491b587fb38b89a3e66a6ba63eb73740336ee49cdebac3ec18bc; bytes 9030.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use RuntimeException;
use SplFileInfo;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Drive\DriveHandle;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\CopyNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\CreateFolderAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\ForceDeleteNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\MoveNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\RenameNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\RestoreNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\TrashNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\UploadFileAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Data\CopyNodeData;
use Vaulter\Drive\Data\CreateDriveFolderData;
use Vaulter\Drive\Data\MoveNodeData;
use Vaulter\Drive\Data\RenameNodeData;
use Vaulter\Drive\Data\UploadFileData;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Drive;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeReadRepository;

/**
 * The ergonomic Drive handle bound to one (Storage, panel) for a host entity —
 * the surface `Vaulter::for($entity)` returns. Every method is a thin delegation
 * to a final readonly Action (write) or NodeReadRepository (read); the handle adds
 * no business logic, only the convenience of a pre-resolved storage + the
 * stream-normalisation that keeps the Actions free of HTTP/PSR types.
 *
 * Authorization (M2a / H.2) is enforced at the HTTP controller boundary
 * (NodeController + AccessResolver) before these methods are reached — the handle
 * itself stays a pure delegation surface and performs no access checks, mirroring
 * the legacy DocumentVisibilityService placement canon.
 */
final readonly class DriveContext implements DriveHandle
{
    public function __construct(
        private Drive $storage,
        private string $panel,
        private StorageManager $storages,
        private NodeReadRepository $nodes,
        private CreateFolderAction $createFolder,
        private UploadFileAction $uploadFile,
        private MoveNodeAction $moveNode,
        private RenameNodeAction $renameNode,
        private CopyNodeAction $copyNode,
        private TrashNodeAction $trashNode,
        private RestoreNodeAction $restoreNode,
        private ForceDeleteNodeAction $forceDeleteNode,
    ) {}

    public function storage(): Drive
    {
        return $this->storage;
    }

    public function panel(): string
    {
        return $this->panel;
    }

    /**
     * The storage's root folder node (§2.1).
     */
    public function root(): Node
    {
        return $this->storages->root($this->storage);
    }

    public function createFolder(string $name, ?Node $parent = null, int|string|null $actorId = null): Node
    {
        return $this->createFolder->execute(new CreateDriveFolderData(
            storage: $this->storage,
            name: $name,
            parent: $parent ?? $this->root(),
            actorId: $actorId,
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Upload bytes into the Drive (§2.4). $source may be a PSR StreamInterface, an
     * SplFileInfo / UploadedFile, an open stream resource, or a raw string — all
     * normalised to a seekable resource before the Action stages and dedups it.
     * $into is the destination folder (null = root); $name overrides the stored
     * name. Typed mixed so core need not hard-require psr/http-message.
     */
    public function upload(
        mixed $source,
        ?Node $into = null,
        ?string $name = null,
        ?string $mimeType = null,
        ?string $originalName = null,
        int|string|null $actorId = null,
    ): Node {
        $stream = $this->toStream($source);
        $resolvedOriginalName = $originalName ?? $this->originalNameFor($source) ?? ($name ?? 'upload.bin');

        return $this->uploadFile->execute(new UploadFileData(
            storage: $this->storage,
            stream: $stream,
            originalName: $resolvedOriginalName,
            mimeType: $mimeType ?? $this->mimeTypeFor($source),
            into: $into ?? $this->root(),
            name: $name,
            actorId: $actorId,
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Upload a NEW VERSION onto an existing file node (§2.4): number bumps,
     * the head repoints, the prior version is superseded.
     */
    public function uploadVersion(
        Node $target,
        mixed $source,
        ?string $mimeType = null,
        ?string $originalName = null,
        int|string|null $actorId = null,
    ): Node {
        $stream = $this->toStream($source);
        $resolvedOriginalName = $originalName ?? $this->originalNameFor($source) ?? $target->name;

        return $this->uploadFile->execute(new UploadFileData(
            storage: $this->storage,
            stream: $stream,
            originalName: $resolvedOriginalName,
            mimeType: $mimeType ?? $this->mimeTypeFor($source),
            targetNode: $target,
            actorId: $actorId,
        ));
    }

    public function move(Node $node, ?Node $into = null, int|string|null $actorId = null): Node
    {
        return $this->moveNode->execute(new MoveNodeData(
            node: $node,
            into: $into ?? $this->root(),
            actorId: $actorId,
        ));
    }

    public function rename(Node $node, string $name, int|string|null $actorId = null): Node
    {
        return $this->renameNode->execute(new RenameNodeData(
            node: $node,
            name: $name,
            actorId: $actorId,
        ));
    }

    public function copy(Node $node, ?Node $into = null, ?string $name = null, int|string|null $actorId = null): Node
    {
        return $this->copyNode->execute(new CopyNodeData(
            node: $node,
            into: $into ?? $this->root(),
            name: $name,
            actorId: $actorId,
        ));
    }

    public function trash(Node $node, int|string|null $actorId = null): Node
    {
        return $this->trashNode->execute(node: $node, actorId: $actorId);
    }

    public function restore(Node $node, int|string|null $actorId = null): Node
    {
        return $this->restoreNode->execute(node: $node, actorId: $actorId);
    }

    public function forceDelete(Node $node, int|string|null $actorId = null): void
    {
        $this->forceDeleteNode->execute(node: $node, actorId: $actorId);
    }

    /**
     * Direct children of a folder (or the root when null) — the hot listing.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, Node>
     */
    public function list(?Node $folder = null): Collection
    {
        return $this->nodes->children(storage: $this->storage, parent: $folder ?? $this->root())->get();
    }

    /**
     * Normalise an upload source to a seekable byte stream resource. A PSR
     * StreamInterface is detached / re-read; an SplFileInfo / UploadedFile is
     * opened; an already-open resource is used as-is.
     *
     * @return resource
     */
    private function toStream(mixed $source): mixed
    {
        if (is_resource($source)) {
            return $source;
        }

        // PSR-7 StreamInterface — detected without a hard dependency: core does
        // not require psr/http-message, so we guard on its presence at runtime.
        if (is_object($source) && is_a($source, 'Psr\Http\Message\StreamInterface')) {
            return $this->streamFromString((string) $source);
        }

        if ($source instanceof SplFileInfo) {
            $handle = @fopen($source->getPathname(), 'rb');

            if ($handle === false) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Unable to open upload source [{$source->getPathname()}].");
            }

            return $handle;
        }

        if (is_string($source)) {
            return $this->streamFromString($source);
        }

        throw new RuntimeException(
            'Vaulter upload source must be a stream resource, PSR StreamInterface, SplFileInfo/UploadedFile or string.',
        );
    }

    /**
     * @return resource
     */
    private function streamFromString(string $bytes): mixed
    {
        $stream = fopen('php://temp', 'r+b');

        if ($stream === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Unable to open an in-memory stream for the upload.');
        }

        fwrite($stream, $bytes);
        rewind($stream);

        return $stream;
    }

    private function originalNameFor(mixed $source): ?string
    {
        if ($source instanceof SplFileInfo) {
            // UploadedFile exposes the client's original filename; SplFileInfo
            // falls back to the on-disk basename.
            if (method_exists($source, 'getClientOriginalName')) {
                /** @var string $name */
                $name = $source->getClientOriginalName();

                return $name;
            }

            return $source->getFilename();
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function mimeTypeFor(mixed $source): ?string
    {
        if ($source instanceof SplFileInfo && method_exists($source, 'getMimeType')) {
            /** @var string|null $mime */
            $mime = $source->getMimeType();

            return $mime;
        }

        return null;
    }
}

```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Container\Container;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Drive\DriveHandle;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Drive\DriveHandleFactory;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\CopyNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\CreateFolderAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\ForceDeleteNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\MoveNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\RenameNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\RestoreNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\TrashNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\UploadFileAction;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Drive;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeReadRepository;

/**
 * The vaulter-drive implementation of the core {@see DriveHandleFactory} seam
 * (P2 #5 / ADR-0015). It wires the StorageManager, NodeReadRepository and the eight
 * Drive Actions into a {@see DriveContext}, so `Vaulter::for()` / `Vaulter::forStorage()`
 * (defined in core's VaulterManager) return a working handle without core ever
 * referencing a Drive class. Bound to the contract by VaulterDriveServiceProvider.
 */
final readonly class DriveManager implements DriveHandleFactory
{
    public function __construct(
        private Container $container,
    ) {}

    public function forOwner(Model $entity, string $panel): DriveHandle
    {
        $storage = $this->container->make(StorageManager::class)->forOwner(owner: $entity, panel: $panel);

        return $this->forStorage($storage);
    }

    public function forStorage(Drive $storage): DriveHandle
    {
        return new DriveContext(
            storage: $storage,
            panel: $storage->profile,
            storages: $this->container->make(StorageManager::class),
            nodes: $this->container->make(NodeReadRepository::class),
            createFolder: $this->container->make(CreateFolderAction::class),
            uploadFile: $this->container->make(UploadFileAction::class),
            moveNode: $this->container->make(MoveNodeAction::class),
            renameNode: $this->container->make(RenameNodeAction::class),
            copyNode: $this->container->make(CopyNodeAction::class),
            trashNode: $this->container->make(TrashNodeAction::class),
            restoreNode: $this->container->make(RestoreNodeAction::class),
            forceDeleteNode: $this->container->make(ForceDeleteNodeAction::class),
        );
    }
}
```

## packages/drive/src/Enums/BulkAction.php

SHA256 fb259c2c574188b96d735cd2b99fd581df070cc57c37380cb4f99cccea6624d0; bytes 1094.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Enums;

use Vaulter\Attributes\Label;
use Vaulter\Support\Concerns\HasLabel;

enum BulkAction: string
{
    use HasLabel;

    #[Label('Delete')]
    case Delete = 'delete';

    #[Label('Restore')]
    case Restore = 'restore';

    #[Label('Move')]
    case Move = 'move';

    #[Label('Delete permanently')]
    case ForceDelete = 'force-delete';

    /** The document ability required to perform this action. */
    public function ability(): string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Delete => 'delete',
            self::Move => 'edit',
            self::Restore, self::ForceDelete => 'manage',
        };
    }

    /** Whether the action operates on trashed (soft-deleted) documents. */
    public function operatesOnTrash(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Restore || $this === self::ForceDelete;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public static function values(): array
    {
        return array_map(static fn (self $action): string => $action->value, self::cases());
    }
}
```

```php
namespace Vaulter\Drive\Events;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Events\ShouldDispatchAfterCommit;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * A node and its subtree were permanently soft-deleted (deleted_at set), their
 * version↔blob edges detached so the blobs become GC-eligible (M1b GC reclaims
 * the bytes — never deleted directly here, §2.4 / §2.3). used_bytes was
 * decremented by the freed live size. The node objects are gone, so only the ids
 * and the reclaimed byte total travel with the event.
 *
 * Dispatched inside the force-delete transaction, so — like every sibling Drive
 * event — it implements ShouldDispatchAfterCommit: listeners (GC scheduling,
 * notifications) only fire once the soft-delete + edge detach is durable, and
 * never on a rolled-back attempt.
 *
 * @property list<int|string> $nodeIds
 */
final readonly class NodeForceDeleted implements ShouldDispatchAfterCommit
{
    public string $eventId;

    /**
     * @param list<int|string> $nodeIds

        public int|string $storageId,
        public array $nodeIds,
        public int $freedBytes,
        public int|string|null $actorId = null,
        ?string $eventId = null,
    ) {
        $this->eventId = $eventId ?? (string) Str::ulid();
    }
}
```

```php
/**
 * A move/copy targeted a parent in a DIFFERENT storage tree (§2.2 — drive_id
 * is the tree boundary). A single parent_id UPDATE cannot cross storages without
 * re-homing the whole subtree, so the operation is rejected explicitly rather
 * than corrupting the tree.
 */
final class CrossStorageMoveException extends VaulterException implements ProblemException
{
    private const string PROBLEM_CODE = 'cross_drive_operation';

    private const int HTTP_STATUS = 409;

    public static function between(int|string $fromStorageId, int|string $toStorageId): self
    {
        return new self(
            "[Vaulter] Cannot move a node from storage [{$fromStorageId}] into storage [{$toStorageId}]. ".
            'Fix: a move stays within one storage tree — copy across storages or re-home explicitly instead. '.
            'Docs: '.self::docs('cross-storage-move'),
        );
    }

    public function problemCode(): string
    {
        return self::PROBLEM_CODE;
    }

    public function httpStatus(): int
    {
        return self::HTTP_STATUS;
    }
}
```

## packages/drive/src/Exceptions/OffsetMismatchException.php

SHA256 38c7754fa11e46385a81739349855e8d1bde296875fc0169fec650b388a64a0f; bytes 2116.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Exceptions;

use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Contracts\ProblemException;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\VaulterException;

/**
 * The tus PATCH `Upload-Offset` did not match the server's authoritative offset,
 * AND the mismatch is not a matching-range idempotent retransmit (§2.8 / N3 /
 * F-P1.4-02). tus 1.0.0 requires exactly 409 Conflict here — never the bare
 * 302 redirect / 422 a plain Laravel ValidationException renders to — carrying
 * the CURRENT server offset so a real tus client re-reads it and resynchronises.
 *
 * Distinct from `UploadConflictException` (P0.3, F-P1.4-01): that one fires when
 * the row lock itself cannot be acquired (a second PATCH racing the first); this
 * one fires when the lock WAS acquired but the client's declared offset disagrees
 * with the server's.
 */
final class OffsetMismatchException extends VaulterException implements ProblemException
{
    private const string PROBLEM_CODE = 'upload_offset_mismatch';

    private const int HTTP_STATUS = 409;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly int $serverOffset,
    ) {
        parent::__construct(
            "[Vaulter] Upload-Offset does not match the server offset {$this->serverOffset}. ".
            'Fix: re-read the session HEAD to learn the authoritative Upload-Offset and resume. '.
            'Docs: '.self::docs('upload-conflict'),
        );
    }

    public function problemCode(): string
    {
        return self::PROBLEM_CODE;
    }

    public function httpStatus(): int
    {
        return self::HTTP_STATUS;
    }

    public function render(Request $request): JsonResponse|false
    {
        $response = parent::render($request);

        if ($response === false) {
            return false;
        }

        // A tus client needs the authoritative offset and protocol version to resume.
        $response->headers->set('Upload-Offset', (string) $this->serverOffset);
        $response->headers->set('Tus-Resumable', '1.0.0');

        return $response;
    }
}

```

## packages/drive/src/Exceptions/StagedUploadMissingException.php

SHA256 e975a29d1378aa2c73afbb77b35545818b4b7ac0225f7c662a444cfb619cd32d; bytes 2028.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Exceptions;

use Vaulter\Exceptions\Contracts\ProblemException;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\VaulterException;

/**
 * The staged temp of a resumable upload is GONE while the session still claims a
 * non-zero offset (VLT-REMED P5.2 / R-03). This is an impossible state on the happy
 * path — the bytes for [0, offset) were accepted and acknowledged, so the object must
 * exist. It shows up when something else removed the staged object underneath an
 * in-flight PATCH: the sweeper/abort reclaimed it (R-02), the bucket was cleaned by
 * hand, the session's disk was re-pointed, or the storage backend lost the object.
 *
 * The path is FAIL-CLOSED on purpose: appending the new chunk to an absent object
 * would silently drop the already-accepted prefix, the server would answer with a
 * REGRESSED authoritative offset, and the client would finish an upload whose bytes
 * are truncated/reordered — a file corrupted without a single error anywhere. Better
 * a loud 409 that forces the client to re-read HEAD (or restart the upload) than a
 * quietly broken file.
 */
final class StagedUploadMissingException extends VaulterException implements ProblemException
{
    private const string PROBLEM_CODE = 'upload_conflict';

    private const int HTTP_STATUS = 409;

    public static function forSession(string $uploadId, int $offset): self
    {
        return new self(
            "[Vaulter] Upload session [{$uploadId}] claims offset {$offset} but its staged object is gone — ".
            'the already-received bytes cannot be recovered, so the chunk is refused rather than silently truncating the file. '.
            'Fix: re-read the session HEAD; if the session is no longer open, start a new upload. '.
            'Docs: '.self::docs('staged-upload-missing'),
        );
    }

    public function problemCode(): string
    {
        return self::PROBLEM_CODE;
    }

    public function httpStatus(): int
    {
        return self::HTTP_STATUS;
    }
}

```

## packages/drive/src/Exceptions/UploadConflictException.php

SHA256 ad037ffe68cd71ac59fdb07b8bfbe4baeea9a7ddc30a548ff1725cf1189f4d93; bytes 2499.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Exceptions;

use Vaulter\Exceptions\Contracts\ProblemException;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\VaulterException;

/**
 * A concurrent tus PATCH is already mutating this upload session (§2.8 / N3 /
 * F-P1.4-01). The server serialises the read-modify-write of received_bytes with a
 * row lock held for the whole "read offset → append bytes → advance" window; a
 * second PATCH that cannot take the lock is REJECTED rather than made to wait, so a
 * retry storm never piles up blocked requests. The tus contract puts the burden of
 * preventing concurrent PATCH on the server, and the client's recovery is to re-read
 * HEAD and resume from the authoritative offset.
 *
 * The precise HTTP status mapping (tus 409 Conflict) is owned by a later slice
 * (P3.4/B7); here the handler raises this typed exception and the controller is left
 * untouched beyond what the fix requires.
 */
final class UploadConflictException extends VaulterException implements ProblemException
{
    private const string PROBLEM_CODE = 'upload_conflict';

    private const int HTTP_STATUS = 409;

    public static function forSession(string $uploadId): self
    {
        return new self(
            "[Vaulter] Upload session [{$uploadId}] is being modified by a concurrent request. ".
            'Fix: re-read the session HEAD to learn the authoritative Upload-Offset and resume. '.
            'Docs: '.self::docs('upload-conflict'),
        );
    }

    /**
     * The session left its open states (Expired by the sweeper, Aborted by the client,
     * already Committed) while this PATCH was mid-flight, so the compare-and-set that
     * advances received_bytes matched zero rows (VLT-REMED P5.2 / R-08). It is refused
     * rather than forced through: forcing it would resurrect a terminal session and
     * publish an offset for bytes that no longer exist.
     */
    public static function forClosedSession(string $uploadId): self
    {
        return new self(
            "[Vaulter] Upload session [{$uploadId}] is no longer open — it was expired or aborted while this chunk was in flight. ".
            'Fix: re-read the session HEAD; a terminal session is never re-opened, so start a new upload. '.
            'Docs: '.self::docs('upload-conflict'),
        );
    }

    public function problemCode(): string
    {
        return self::PROBLEM_CODE;
    }

    public function httpStatus(): int
    {
        return self::HTTP_STATUS;
    }
}

```

```php
    {

    }

    {
        return self::HTTP_STATUS;
    }

    protected function renderExtras(): array
    {
```
